name: dingtalk_chat_history
description: Read the DingTalk macOS app directly, with no API: scripts/dingtalk-ax drives the running app through the Accessibility API (list conversations, read the open conversation's messages) and the model judges the result. macOS only; needs Accessibility permission for the process running laya-workflow, and `policy.allow_exec`. Pass the tool path: --state '{"tool":"<abs>/scripts/dingtalk-ax"}'.

read_ok.instructions: Did reading the DingTalk conversation list return any conversations?

criteria.B: no, the read failed or returned nothing

needs_attention.instructions: Given the DingTalk conversation list and the open conversation's messages above, does anything need the user's attention right now?

criteria.B: yes, something is urgent or needs a reply
